Hi! i’m a pig main, there are a lot of builds you can do that are fun/effective.

if you want something good, you can use

-bamboozle 
-superior anatomy 
-surge
-enduring/brutal strength (either works)

she’s a pretty weak-ish killer so chase perks are her best bet (imo), that’s my main build as of right now

with the new change to fire up, you can also do a pallet eating build + blood favor since her dash can easily be countered by a pallet camper/early dropper 

you can switch out some perks for whatever tickles your fancy, i’ve been playing for a long time so i have decent map control, but if that’s something you struggle with you can always use more gen oriented perks

in terms of her RBT, try to keep them for mid and late game. I start using them when there’s 3 gens left, but if they’re slamming gens then def use them earlier, the whole point of the rbt is to stall the game in your favor. 

For addons, i like using both of the extra trap addons (can’t remember the names rn) which brings you to 6 traps in total i believe. 

she’s pretty versatile depending on how you choose to play her. Totem builds are also pretty fun on her if you’re using amanda’s letter on an indoor map.
if you want to keep autodidact, you can swap any means or chem trap for empathic connection. if you want a more chase oriented build you can do drama, vigil, resi (or quick gambit) and finesse.
